hooks.command: command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; p=$(cat); printf '%s' "$p" | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-live-theme.ps1"; rc=$?; case $rc in 0|2) exit $rc;; esac; if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eiq shopify && printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eiq theme; then echo "BLOCKED (guard-live-theme): PowerShell could not run this guard (exit $rc) and the command names a Shopify theme. The guard is what holds the live theme, so a call it cannot judge is refused rather than waved through. Retry the command once; if PowerShell stays unhealthy on this machine, run the theme command yourself." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit $rc
